name: Gem of Serpentis
summary: Deep in the Wailing Caverns, Lord Serpentis keeps the Gem of Serpentis close. The enchanted dream gem binds his will to the corrupted vision reshaping the caverns and threatening the Barrens.

sections.title: Heart of the Serpentine Dream
sections.body: Naralex fell into slumber in the Wailing Caverns, and the Emerald Nightmare reached him there. His most devoted followers became the fanatical Druids of the Fang. Lord Serpentis leads one part of the cabal, with three other leaders beside him. Each carries an enchanted dream gem, binding their shared will to the corrupted vision. Recovering Serpentis's gem breaks his hold over the caverns' life and strikes at the leaders directing corruption across the Barrens.

sections.title: Proof for Thunder Bluff
sections.body: The tauren druids on Thunder Bluff's Elder Rise suffer vivid nightmares from corruption beneath the savannah. Nara Wildmane is among those troubled. The gems of Serpentis, Cobrahn, Anacondra, and Pythas prove that the rogue order's leaders have fallen. Recovering them eases the nightmare's hold on the Cenarion Circle in Mulgore.

faq.q: Where does the Gem of Serpentis come from?
faq.answer: Lord Serpentis carries the gem deep in the winding waterways of the Wailing Caverns. He is one of the four leaders of the Druids of the Fang.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the gem?
aliases: why do i need gem of serpentis
what is gem of serpentis for
faq.answer: The gem is one of four that the Druids of the Fang's leaders use to channel the nightmare warping the subterranean oasis. Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff seeks it as proof that Lord Serpentis has been defeated.

faq.q: Who wants all four dream gems?
aliases: leaders of the fang turn in
faq.answer: Nara Wildmane asks you to bring her the gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas, and Serpentis. She is a druid on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. Together, the gems can sever the nightmare's hold over the region.

faq.q: Who was Lord Serpentis before carrying this gem?
faq.answer: Lord Serpentis was once a disciple of Naralex who entered the caverns to restore lush life to the Barrens. The Emerald Nightmare twisted his hopes into a fanatical desire to remake the world in serpent form.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see the danger in Serpentis and his cabal's dream gems. Deep communion with the Dream demands vigilant spiritual discipline.
As a tauren, you know that breaking Serpentis's hold on the gem helps free Thunder Bluff's shamans and druids from the dark visions disturbing their sleep across Mulgore.
